verdict.rationale: Fellow documents no user-configurable automation or rules engine. The scope review explicitly finds no in-product trigger-action configuration and no automation, rule or trigger help articles. Webhooks and the REST API are developer building blocks: the integrator must supply the receiving endpoint and all action logic. Fellow's automatic per-meeting summaries are fixed built-in behavior, not automations a user sets up, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: This enables you to build integrations that react immediately to changes in Fellow, without needing to poll for updates.
